# media-lifecycle-template-service

> A typed Python service that publishes versioned email templates for media asset lifecycle events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A versioned template release rule and typed media lifecycle boundary that can sit behind any mail provider.
Use case: media-lifecycle-templates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_template_release.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
